title: CARE-Bench: A Benchmark of Diverse Client Simulations Guided by Expert Principles for Evaluating LLMs in Psychological Counseling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing LLM counseling performance (therapeutic relationship, empathy, and counseling skills) across simulated clients with different Big Five personality traits (e.g., high vs. low openness, neuroticism).
Comparing the counseling effectiveness and multidimensional evaluation scores of LLMs when interacting with simulated clients from different age groups (0-11, 12-19, 20-39, 40-64, 65+).
Measuring and comparing LLM psychological counseling performance scores between male and female simulated client profiles to identify performance disparities.
